July wrap-up: One month in global
markets
Our latest Global Markets Snapshot breaks
down a month of trends in the equity, debt, and
commodities markets—tracking returns across
a range of indexes and sectors. It also features
private market activity, including major deals,
fundraising, IPO performance, lending volume,
and unicorn creation.
In this monthly digest, we provide the datasets
that the PitchBook Institutional Research Group
is keeping an eye on as markets remain volatile.
